result.summary: The main visual issue in this app screen is a missing text label or branding for the item located at the bottom of the page, where a -100% badge is present but the restaurant name is absent.

issues.description: The item featured at the bottom of the screen (a pizza) lacks a title, rating, delivery time, and cost information.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the restaurant name and associated metadata are rendered correctly alongside the image to allow users to identify and select the item.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' section image for 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' is partially obscured by the layout, making the '€0 delivery' label look slightly cramped.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the padding or the image crop area to ensure the badge has sufficient breathing room.
